{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "l0rinc",
      "stance": "objection",

    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",

      "note": "withdrew initial ACK after measuring an AssembleBlock regression; suggested testing real block creation timings"

      "login": "Sjors",

      "note": "Concept ACK for speeding up checkBlock IPC for Stratum v2"
    },
    {
      "login": "optout21",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "supported performance improvement follow-up; suggested reusing ConnectBlockView"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5051664610",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "provide a reproducible way to test the performance claim using deterministic proposals or a microbenchmark",
      "quote": "Could you provide a reproducible way to test the performance claim, ideally using a deterministic set of mainnet block proposals or a microbenchmark?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author updated the AssembleBlock benchmark and provided before/after measurements",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5053739755",
        "c:5118541917"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5118541917",
      "status_by_quote": "I've included an additional commit at the start that improves the AssembleBlock benchmark by filling the block to max we"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5058239886",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "slowdown in AssembleBlock benchmark when using overlay view",
      "quote": "I see it in the report too, and can measure the slowdown locally as well.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author pushed a commit updating the benchmark to fill blocks to max weight, resolving the measured regression",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5118541917"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5118541917",
      "status_by_quote": "I've included an additional commit at the start that improves the AssembleBlock benchmark by filling the block to max we"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5058336826",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "introduce a heuristic to skip background fetching if the block does not spend many coins",
      "quote": "Maybe it would be worthwhile to introduce a heuristic where we skip background fetching if the block does not spend a lot of coins?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author declined, explaining blocks spending few coins are already fast",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5118541917"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5118541917",
      "status_by_quote": "what we really care about is that slow blocks are faster. A block spending few coins is already very fast, and so speedi"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4880773604",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "use the newly introduced ConnectBlockView() helper for m_connect_block_view at line 3055",
      "quote": "Could this also use the newly introduced ConnectBlockView()?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated the callsite to use ConnectBlockView()",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5227266815"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5227266815",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4912955569",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "reentrant calls to TestBlockValidity reusing ConnectBlockView while a synchronous callback is active during a fetch",
      "quote": "I think the reentrancy issue needs to be addressed before this can be merged.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author proposed an assert to guard against reentrancy; reviewer agreed in rc:3866882847 but the fix has not yet been pushed",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3839674305"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3839674305",
      "status_by_quote": "We can prevent this by calling Assert(overlay_view.GetCacheSize() == 0); inside TestBlockValidity."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3790983748",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "assert the max weight claim in the benchmark and adjust FAN_OUT to make it true",
      "quote": "can we assert the claim (and adjust the FAN_OUT to make it true? Just make sure the number is not 110, we're still sensitive to that...)",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5957437978",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "measure real block creation timings side-by-side with master on a similar mempool",
      "quote": "I think it would be interesting to add some more real block creation timings, i.e. run this side-by-side with master on hopefully a similar mempool and see if there is a difference.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed to gather real-world data and marked the PR as draft",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5958877977"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5958877977",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes, good idea. I will try and gather some real world data with this. Marking as draft until I figure out the above."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4203614973",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "avoid repeated mempool checks during fixture setup in the AssembleBlock benchmark by passing -checkmempool=0",
      "quote": "Nit: the fixture checks the entire growing mempool after each insertion, we could probably disable those  checks.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4203826319",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "StartFetching can retain up to ~250 MiB of coins on invalid block templates before validation failure, creating a potential memory allocation risk without PoW protection",
      "quote": "Before #35295, coins were fetched as validation reached each transaction, so any failure avoided fetching later transactions, but `StartFetching()` can now retain those coins before validation rejects",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "reviewer pushed back that untrusted submitters do not need PoW or valid signatures to trigger prefetching and coin allocation",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4208127181"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4213588131",
      "status_by_quote": "These fetches happen before input validation, so the submitter doesn’t need PoW or valid signatures to trigger them."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:5061422051",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "making the checkBlock() IPC faster, intended to be called frequently by the Job Declarator Server role in Stratum v2",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4880773604",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "Another performance improvement, a must-have follow-up of #35295/#34164/#31132, looks good.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": [
        "src/validation.cpp"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "gather real-world benchmark data while PR is in draft, push agreed reentrancy check, and address reviewer pushback regarding memory allocation without PoW",
      "id": "c:5958877977"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "l0rinc contested the author's reply on rc:4203826319, pointing out that input validation has not occurred yet so submitters do not need PoW or valid signatures to trigger UTXO prefetching."
}
